limitations: Three activations from one 200-input/3-output request; no general bitwise guarantee.
Standalone warmed projection clocks are not operation attribution inside the real model.
Paired wall and GPU ranges all cross zero; local speedup is unestablished.
Native executes one command buffer; ggml executes two; host execution boundaries differ.
No shader ISA inspected; identical source arithmetic and zero observed error do not prove identical machine instructions.
Offline xcrun metal compilation unavailable because MetalToolchain component is absent; runtime source compilation and all GPU checks pass.
CPU/CUDA and other model geometries are unmeasured; row-tail test uses257rows from the same real matrix.
next_hypothesis: Attribute the full-model output projection and compare attainable device-read bandwidth before selecting a lossless weight-layout/work-mapping change; separately test a larger gate/up/SiLU/down FFN tile consumer with bounded partial reductions. The paired-load result rejects no broader backend design.
